title: The built file works from file://
rationale: Local-only means a double-click start: one script proves the bundle does not need a server.
hint: Add scripts/check-file-protocol.mjs and an npm script check:file.

title: CSP forbids all network connections
rationale: connect-src 'none' makes "your data never leaves your machine" a property of the build, not a promise.

title: Stored data carries a schema version
rationale: Files outlive releases; without a version there is no safe migration.

title: The real build is tested with a browser
rationale: file:// and bundling issues only show up in the built artefact.

title: Deletes are soft
rationale: Tombstones keep sync and undo possible; hard purge happens after a grace period.

title: Browser file APIs live in one module
rationale: A single adapter keeps the domain testable and the platform risk contained.
hint: Only src/data/fs may import the File System Access API.

title: Writes survive crashes
rationale: Debounced persistence needs an emergency copy so a crash loses seconds, not hours.

title: No network access in the code
rationale: Complements the CSP: the code itself must not try.
hint: Review: no fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket or sendBeacon.
